title: The add-a-profile onboarding wizard (ADR-062)
headSub: Three quick steps on the Profiles screen, tracked by session_state.onboard_step (1 -> 2 -> 3). Each step is one API call; steps 2 and 3 are skippable; the finished profile then drives a pre-filled New search.

takeaway.text: Three steps, three writes: {{green:POST /users}} (identity), {{green:POST .../resume}} (parsed), {{green:PUT /config}} (search defaults). Steps 2-3 skip cleanly; the new profile then pre-fills New search. Identity is cooperative - no auth (ADR-062).
